'''Calvin Sanders''' programmed the [[Star Wars CCG Palace]] with [[Dale Maurice]] and walked the site at the 14 March 1997 Grand Opening party.<ref name="palace-party">[http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/index.html Special Events], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327205534/http://rothko.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/index.html Internet Archive]</ref> He is credited on Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>
